tool_schemas.name: create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified workspace and team, optionally assigning it to a project, and returns the created issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID does not match the required lin_* pattern, if priority/status is not one of the allowed values, if due_date is not ISO 8601 date-time, or if unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id, team_id, or provided project_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create issues in that workspace/team.

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace the issue belongs to (lin_ws_...).

team_id.description: ID of the team the issue belongs to (lin_team_...).

project_id.description: Optional ID of the project the issue belongs to (lin_prj_...).

labels.description: List of label names applied to the issue.

due_date.description: Optional due date/time in ISO 8601 format.

tool_schemas.name: list_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues in a workspace, optionally filtered by team, project, status, priority, label, and created/updated time ranges, and returns a page of results sorted per sort/order. Results are paginated with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; omit cursor for the first page and use the returned cursor to fetch the next page until no further cursor is provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid enum values, malformed timestamps, limit out of range, or unknown fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id (or any provided filter IDs) does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to list issues in the workspace.

label.description: Filter to issues containing this label.

created_after.description: Filter to issues created after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Filter to issues created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_after.description: Filter to issues updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

updated_before.description: Filter to issues updated before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing issue (title, description, priority, status, labels, due_date, project_id, team_id) and returns the updated issue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id/team_id/project_id formats are invalid, if priority/status is not allowed, if due_date is not ISO 8601 date-time, or if unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue_id does not exist or is not accessible, or if the provided team_id/project_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to modify the issue or move it to the specified team/project.

issue_id.description: ID of the issue to update (lin_iss_...).

labels.description: Replace the issue's labels with this list.

due_date.description: Updated due date/time in ISO 8601 format (or null to clear).

project_id.description: Updated project assignment (lin_prj_...) or null to clear.

team_id.description: Move issue to a different team (lin_team_...).

tool_schemas.name: list_teams
tool_schemas.description: Lists teams in a workspace with optional status filtering and returns a paginated result set sorted per sort/order. Results are paginated with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; omit cursor for the first page and pass the returned cursor to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, invalid status/sort/order, limit out of range, or unknown fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to view teams in the workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in a workspace, optionally filtered by project status, and returns a paginated result set sorted per sort/order. Results are paginated with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; omit cursor for the first page and use the returned cursor for the next page until exhausted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, invalid status/sort/order, limit out of range, or unknown fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to view projects in the workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search_issues
tool_schemas.description: Performs full-text search over issues in a workspace using the provided query, optionally constrained by team, project, status, and priority, and returns a paginated list of matching issues sorted by relevance or the requested time field. Results are paginated with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; omit cursor for the first page and pass the returned cursor to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid enum values, empty/invalid query, limit out of range, or unknown fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id (or provided team_id/project_id) does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to search issues in the workspace.

query.description: Full-text query string to search in issues.

team_id.description: Optional team filter for the search (lin_team_...).

project_id.description: Optional project filter for the search (lin_prj_...).

status.description: Optional status filter for the search.

priority.description: Optional priority filter for the search (0-4).

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the full issue record for the specified issue_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id does not match the required lin_iss_* pattern or if unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view the issue.

issue_id.description: ID of the issue to retrieve (lin_iss_...).

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the caller-accessible workspace by id and returns the workspace record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is not a valid lin_ws_... id. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace is not accessible to the caller.

metadata.name: Linear MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a Linear-like workspace with teams, projects, and issues, supporting creation, updates, listing, and retrieval. It also supports full-text search over issues and basic API auditing of requests so the MCP tools can list/search/get and mutate issues reliably. Repository: https://gi
